author: nihprodne
description: A Cold War-era truck depot and logistics base for the Caucasus: supply and fuel trucks, cargo containers, ammo pallets and fuel barrels around an outpost, command center and buildings, all ringed with sandbag emplacements and light air defenses (ZU-23, ZSU-23-4 Shilka, DShK) plus a few infantry. Not tied to a fixed position, so you can drop it anywhere.
